title: Quench Vat
pages: Craft the vat as XYI / AWA / IAI (X soaked billet from the Soaking Hearth, Y Tempered Copper Sheet from the Copper Hot Press, I iron ingot, A kiln-made annealed copper, W vanilla cauldron). Both the Hearth and Hot Press follow the Kiln; the vat output then gates the Pressure Press. Material update: crafting slot 3 (row-major 3x3) now requires a chromium ingot via forge:ingots/chromium for the corrosion-resistant tank lining. Chromium comes from thermite charges fired in the Kiln, which the vat already follows; all existing progression gates remain required.

Right-click to open. The left slot holds the hot material, the tank fills from a held water bucket or any Forge fluid handler aimed at the block. The solid and the measured water are consumed together; the right slot holds the result. Crank supplies 80 FE like other t0/t1 machines. When a batch advances, the vent and water surface brighten and a valve cue sounds; they settle after twenty idle ticks. A completed batch gives a separate splash cue.

Twenty-four datapack recipes cover genuinely different rapid-cooling paths: two kiln-made steel billets quench into one tempered steel (the press's second gate item), magma block cools into basalt, netherrack into blackstone, one magma cream desolidifies into one slime ball using 125 mB water, two swaged Bearing Race Blanks harden into two Hardened Bearing Races (250 mB, 120 ticks, 12 FE/t), two Thrust Washer Blanks harden the same way into Hardened Thrust Washers, one broached Guide Rail Blank hardens into a Hardened Guide Rail (250 mB, 160 ticks, 12 FE/t) for the Linear Guide, two riveted Tapered Roller Blanks harden into two Tapered Rollers (250 mB, 120 ticks, 12 FE/t) for the Tapered Roller Bearing, one Flywheel Rim Blank shrinks onto its cast hub as a Shrink-Fit Flywheel (500 mB, 160 ticks, 12 FE/t) for the Press Drive Train, and sixteen further vanilla stones/blocks each cool into a distinct smoothed or compacted building variant. Four stone, basalt, andesite, diorite, granite or blackstone quench into five smooth or polished blocks (250 mB, 100 ticks), beating the furnace or stonecutter; sandstone, red sandstone and end stone stay four-for-four because other machines can reverse them. No two recipes share an input or output pair. Terracotta rehydrates into exactly one clay block, the same block the Rack Smoker fires back, so the pair never multiplies clay.

Recipes are datapack JSON under data/<namespace>/recipes/quenching. Type: arcana_industry:quenching. Fields: ingredient, count (default 1), fluid, fluid_amount (1-8000 mB), result, duration (1-72000 ticks), energy_per_tick (1-1000) and optional priority (default 0, ties break by ascending recipe ID). Unlike mixing there is no second/binder slot.

Automation matches the refractory mixer: top and horizontal item ports import the solid, the bottom exports results, and the fluid capability accepts water from any side. Six buttons cycle each face through Off, In and Out. Inventory, tank, FE, work and ports persist through saves and chunk unloads.

With Just Enough Items installed, click the progress strip to browse Quenching recipes, or look up an ingredient or product in JEI. The vat is the category catalyst. JEI is optional; all processing and this guide work without it.
